name: 79410 · Lubbock, TX
findings: ZIP 79410 (Lubbock) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 28 of them (49%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 21 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 79410 (Lubbock) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 79410 (Lubbock) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.1 times the typical level).
